title: ID0399954-DC/Si-D/IT - [xzaakn] charger issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
our backend system reports the following pattern several times a day:
- Connector is not available for charging
- Request Plug status information
- Charging point is Available and not in use
Root cause: COAPS error
Solution:
Timeout between outlet & controlled auto fixed.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: Notes from Customer
additional_info.body:
Good Afternoon,
I'd like to point out an anomaly on the charger. The last recharge was dispensed on 8/1. From that date, our backend system reports the following pattern several times a day:
- Connector is not available for charging
- Request Plug status information
- Charging point is Available and not in use
I ask you to check from your backend system if the charger is available and if the sockets are working.
Regards,
Luigi Iodice
Software Version: v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164
OCPP Backend Connection: No

additional_info.subject: RE: 0399954 - ID0399954-DC/Si-D/IT - [xzaakn] charger issue CRM:00796001162
additional_info.body:
Hi Luigi Iodice,
Greetings of the day,
I found that the issue occurred because Outlet 2 experienced an internal communication loss with the charger’s controller due to a timeout error, which was resolved automatically by retrying the connection. Kindly let us know if you are still encountering this error. In the logs, I found that this occurred on January 8, 2025, after which the outlet became unavailable.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
